pulse.text: **Alibaba open-weighted a Max-class flagship for the first time**: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B — 2.4T total, 95B active, 262K context extensible past 1M — landed on Hugging Face on Aug 12 scoring **92.6 GPQA Diamond and 67.7 SWE-bench Pro**, though the open checkpoint is text-only and drops the hosted Max's vision, non-thinking mode and built-in tools, under Alibaba's own license rather than Apache. OpenAI's move today was speed rather than scale: a limited-preview **Ultrafast** tier serves the full GPT-5.6 Sol on Cerebras wafer-scale hardware at up to **750 output tokens per second, about 14x standard**. The leaderboard itself did not move — **Claude Opus 5 still leads at 63** on the AA Intelligence Index, over Fable 5 at 62 and a Grok 4.6 / GPT-5.6 Sol tie at 61. Release odds did: Kalshi's Gemini 3.5 Pro by Aug 31 **collapsed to 21% from 51%** while OpenAI firmed on both fronts, with Astra by Sep 30 up to **80% from 76%** and GPT-6 before October at 51%, up from 44%. Worth watching: Alibaba's 27B sibling is still unshipped against an Aug 15 target, and Anthropic's grip on the September best-model market holds at **87%**.
